description: themes/hello-friend is a vendored 2021 snapshot of an upstream theme.
Its package.json and yarn.lock drive a webpack build that produced the
already-committed static/assets/*, and nothing here ever runs them: no
layout uses Hugo Pipes, so Hugo copies the prebuilt CSS and JS verbatim.
Renovate cannot regenerate those artifacts, so npm PRs would churn the
lockfile without changing a byte of what deploys, while surfacing inert
webpack-4 CVEs as though they were live. Hence ignorePaths.

packageRules.description: Hugo comes from the flake, and public/ is committed rather than built on deploy, so a toolchain bump cannot break the live site on its own. Group it into one PR a week.
